baseline.scope: existing local artifacts + NodeCompat-only resource concatenation model, no application/config/icon files and no fresh native build

isolation.note: Dependencies and build outputs are confined to this temporary project.

buildSettings.compressionMeasurement: Node zlib gzipSync/deflateRawSync of emitted minified JS bytes, level 6

entryTexts.fflate:
import { gzip, gunzip, gzipSync, gunzipSync } from 'fflate/browser';
export { gzip, gunzip, gzipSync, gunzipSync };

buildSettings.installCommand: npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --save-exact @noble/hashes@2.4.0 buffer@6.0.3 readable-stream@4.7.0 fflate@0.8.3 esbuild@0.28.2

limitations: Byte counts describe these pinned package versions, exports, esbuild version, and target only; different export selections, bundler options, runtime polyfills, or source maps change output size.
ESBuild itself uses a platform-native build executable but is a temporary build-time dependency and is not part of measured bundles.
This is JavaScript bundle size only, not a platform release binary delta; no macOS/Windows runtime or package-size verification was performed.
No runtime Node dependency is bundled as an external node: import; readable-stream browser mapping was checked. Some pure-JS process/buffer/events/string_decoder shims are included when needed.
Noble scrypt/PBKDF2 bundle cost excludes runtime memory/work-factor overhead; scrypt can consume substantial runtime memory and time.
gzip and raw DEFLATE lengths compress the emitted minified entry bytes at level 6; they do not model Niva archive framing or container overhead.

resourceAppendModel.model: Keep all existing NodeCompat assets; append one minified library bundle; raw DEFLATE level6; no removals, filenames, index, config, page or icon added

nativeBudgets.scope: 22 modules; incremental Native release-code estimates only. Every nonzero interval is an unmeasured manual order-of-magnitude budget. Existing fixed dependencies are excluded from per-module deltas.

baselineSnapshot.providedBy: main-thread live file measurement and SHA-256; not rebuilt
baselineSnapshot.note: Not freshly rebuilt and not assumed platform-independent.

sharedNativeBudgets.scenario: One shared POST/body parser, token-authenticated sync API dispatch and error/result mapping; charge once across modules.
sharedNativeBudgets.basis: Current server supports GET only; API manager already defines unary handler/JSON result types. Uses existing smol/serde_json; manually estimated, not built.

sharedNativeBudgets.scenario: One main-frame capture/serialization of fixed process/os facts; charge once, not per process/os API.
sharedNativeBudgets.basis: Trusted main-frame bootstrap already emits window/origin/token; Native process/os getters already provide several values. Snapshot shape is future code, not measured.

modules.scenario: File API extensions; upper range includes a cross-platform watch backend.
modules.basis: Existing std::fs handlers cover basic I/O. Remaining Native code: bounded unary sync I/O, FileHandle registry, lstat/realpath, watch. Rough manual code-plus-small-backend range; no measurement.
unmeasuredDependencyScenarios: notify/platform watcher selection is open; any dependency delta is unmeasured.

modules.scenario: Pure JS path computation; current cwd query reuses existing Native method plus shared syncXHR dispatcher.
modules.basis: No separate Native path module or cwd cache is budgeted; dynamic cwd queries use shared transport.

modules.scenario: Pure JavaScript EventEmitter semantics.
modules.basis: No Native event subsystem required for EventEmitter helpers.

modules.scenario: Existing process getters plus small stdio/event/exit adapters; startup snapshot excluded here.
modules.basis: pid/currentDir/currentExe/env/args/setCurrentDir/exit/version and execStream are already registered; only process event/raw stdio and small semantic extensions may need Native code.

modules.scenario: Node HTTP/HTTPS客户端及应用服务器协议在JS；TCP/TLS Native成本只计入net/tls；内部启动HTTP/WS保留在现有基线。
modules.basis: Reevaluated under JS protocol / shared Native socket architecture; no Native dependency-removal savings credited.

modules.scenario: Node HTTP/HTTPS客户端及应用服务器协议在JS；TCP/TLS Native成本只计入net/tls；内部启动HTTP/WS保留在现有基线。
modules.basis: Reevaluated under JS protocol / shared Native socket architecture; no Native dependency-removal savings credited.

modules.scenario: Pure JS utility APIs.
modules.basis: No Native API or dependency required.

modules.scenario: Add missing dynamic OS facts; reuse os_info/directories for current fields.
modules.basis: Native has type/arch/version/home/temp/separator/EOL. CPU detail, memory, hostname, uptime, interfaces and full userInfo need new collection; low-confidence code budget.
unmeasuredDependencyScenarios: sysinfo/interface crate choice could alter range; not selected or measured.

modules.scenario: Chosen default is noble JS algorithms and browser random; only a strict timingSafeEqual Native helper remains.
modules.basis: Hash/HMAC/PBKDF2/scrypt are selected browser JS candidates. Do not charge Native algorithm crates. A small comparison handler is an unmeasured manual allowance.

alternativeScenarios.scenario: Unselected Native algorithm route, retained only for comparison

modules.scenario: 普通进程扩展；fork已从目标移除，不引入Node runtime。
modules.basis: 复用现有execStream/std::process，补信号、结果及同步适配；0–32KiB是未实测工程预算。

modules.scenario: Node stream constructors/pipeline semantics in JS over existing binary channel.
modules.basis: Niva already transports per-call events/chunks/cancellation; generic Node streams do not require Rust.
sharedDependencies: existing API manager binary WS channel

modules.scenario: JS URL/file-URL helpers.
modules.basis: No Native module required.

modules.scenario: JS Buffer polyfill and typed arrays.
modules.basis: No Native code required.

modules.scenario: Pure JS encoding and decoding.
modules.basis: No Native calls required.

modules.scenario: TCP Socket/connect/server over existing smol TCP primitives.
modules.basis: Niva already has smol TCP listener; Socket lifecycle, half-close, backpressure and events are new glue, not a new network runtime.
unmeasuredDependencyScenarios: No new socket crate assumed; full cross-platform lifecycle not built or measured.

modules.scenario: TLS streams/connect/server over existing sockets and native-tls.
modules.basis: TLS client is already used by ureq; Node TLS connect/server options, certificates and stream binding are missing. Exclude fixed client dependencies.
unmeasuredDependencyScenarios: Server acceptor may newly link native-tls backend symbols; marginal code is unmeasured.

modules.scenario: 只预算系统lookup与DNS配置薄封装；协议codec在JS，UDP/TCP成本在dgram/net中计一次。
modules.basis: Reevaluated under JS protocol / shared Native socket architecture; no Native dependency-removal savings credited.

modules.scenario: UDP sockets using existing smol UDP primitives.
modules.basis: No Node datagram APIs exist; UDP itself can reuse smol. Lifecycle, multicast and event behavior are new Native integration.
unmeasuredDependencyScenarios: No datagram crate assumed; multicast behavior is not measured.

modules.scenario: Chosen fflate/browser JS route, including Sync APIs.
modules.basis: No new Native compression API is needed when using fflate; existing flate2 remains unchanged.

alternativeScenarios.scenario: Alternative Native flate2 exposure, not the chosen JS route

modules.scenario: Pure JS assertion semantics.
modules.basis: No Native API or dependency.

modules.scenario: JS byte decoding helper.
modules.basis: Uses browser byte/string primitives; no Native code.

modules.scenario: Browser timers and JS scheduling wrappers.
modules.basis: Existing browser timer functions; no Native additions.

packagingNote.nodeCompatJs: Selected JS wrappers/runtime files are staged as project resources, not Native Rust code.
packagingNote.macOS: RESOURCE_INDEXES and Deflate-compressed RESOURCE_DATA are separate under .app/Contents/Resources; measure app bundle size separately from executable.
packagingNote.Windows: Project resources are compressed into RESOURCE_DATA and embedded as PE RCDATA; final EXE includes compressed JS assets. Do not add raw JS bytes to Native estimates.

compressionRuntime.implementation: Node node:zlib; not assumed byte-identical to Python zlib, pako or flate2
